annotation.title_clean: Commission Directive 2003/12/EC of 3 February 2003 on the reclassification of breast implants in the framework of Directive 93/42/EEC concerning medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Directive 2003/12/EC of 3 February 2003 on the reclassification of breast implants in the framework of Directive 93/42/EEC concerning medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Directive 2003/12/EC reclassifies breast implants from Class IIb to Class III medical devices under Directive 93/42/EEC, requiring design dossier examination by notified bodies. It sets transitional reassessment rules and Member State transposition deadlines. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Breast implants reclassified as Class III medical devices, derogating from Annex IX of Directive 93/42/EEC.
Implants already on the market must undergo conformity reassessment as Class III before 1 March 2004.
Notified body decisions under Article 11(3)(a) taken before 1 September 2003 may not be extended.
Member States must transpose by 1 August 2003 and apply from 1 September 2003.
